title: Agents
teaser: AI that plans and takes action

basics.say: So far, AI has answered your questions. An agent goes further: you give it a goal, and it works out the steps itself.
Take the goal 'book a meeting room for Friday'. First, it makes a plan – starting with a look at the calendar.
Then it acts, using the tools it's allowed to use, and it observes the result: room 3 is free.
Then it repeats the loop – book the room, confirm with you – until the goal is reached.
Plan, act, observe, repeat: that loop is what makes an agent. It's powerful, so good agents ask before doing anything important.

deeper.say: An agent is an LLM running in a loop, with access to tools. The model picks the next action based on what it has seen so far.
Coding assistants are a good example: they read files, run tests, fix errors and try again, step by step.
More autonomy means more risk. Mistakes can add up over many steps, so people set limits and approve key actions.
Your role shifts from doing each step to giving a clear goal, checking the plan and reviewing the result.

takeaway: An agent pursues a goal in a loop: plan, act, observe, repeat.
